versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei抖音拉视频评论:

- Provides unified skill for Douyin open data: keyword search, creator post fetch, video comments, real-time trending.
- Simple command-line usage with intent recognition and smart parameter inference.
- Pure JSON output, supports up to 10,000 records per command.
- Token management with secure, neutral error handling.
- Strict separation: no content creation, download, or external platform support.
- Complete Chinese documentation; environment requires Node.js ≥16.14 and API token.
